The name Kashvika carries the meaning “Goddess Kali's Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kashvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess kali's victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
